scope_summary: Main-thread script attribution of decision 268 (a)'s accepted desktop CPU excess: the audited build (f10fe585) against step 6's L3 build (c9d29c14, commit a8afeec, md5 verified) and 8E's (d73d0115), on the device route's own motions (Play at half speed 08:30-09:10 under Follow at the Field vantage; the 09:30 Overview orbited by the route's camera writes and by a real right-drag through the app's handler; phase 8's Overview right-dragged; the Overview held), run by the motion driver on Chromium 141 / SwiftShader at 2560x1305 with the native draws stubbed. Two sessions (measure.js: L3, now, now, L3 with profiles; paired.js: L3, 8E, now in palindrome blocks plus load-independent GL and app call counts). Evidence reused from the previous attempt; no re-measurement in this attempt beyond the analysis of the saved paired session. Detail: docs/audit-post8-evidence/perf-attribution/README.md.

findings.title: Decision 268 (a)'s desktop script excess is mostly three.js re-binding 8D/8E's three extra kit attributes on every instanced draw, plus Stage 8's own per-frame app work
findings.user_impact: On the owner's 144 Hz desktop Play's script passes the 6.9 ms frame (section 24.2: about one frame in five or six held two refreshes); accepted as measured by decision 268 (a); not re-required.
findings.evidence: paired.md: Play CPU/frame L3 19.55, 8E 23.88, now 24.03 ms (+22.9%, adjacent pairs +22.8/+22.9%; session 1 +22%); GL calls 10,327 -> 13,227 -> 13,502 a frame at 791/789/802 draws; vertexAttribPointer +1,353, bindBuffer +1,330, useProgram +218 (Play), the same +1,341-1,400 on every Overview motion. summary.md: of the profiled rise (+9.69 ms Play, +8.74 drag) three.js JS + WebGL native +5.54 (57%) / +6.06 (69%), within it three's setup 0.68->1.17, bindBuffer 0.68->1.25, vertexAttribPointer 0.75->1.22 ms; Stage 8 app subsystems about +3.1 (Play: render path/gdepth +0.69, map layer +0.51, culling +0.47, outlines +0.36, updateVisibility +0.33, ground queries +0.23, confidence +0.18, arrows +0.17, gait +0.08, kitLod +0.04).
findings.expected: Section 8.3's CPU line: js50 not above L3's by more than 1 ms on the desktop.
findings.observed: Reproduced on one fixed browser (Chromium 141 for both builds) at the device's ratio (+22-23% here, +25% on the desktop), so the Chrome 155->156 update is not needed to explain it; located between L3 and 8E (8E->now within the spread). Mechanism: three attributes x about 450 instanced kit draws a frame ~ 1,350 extra vertexAttribPointer/bindBuffer pairs (inference from counts and code; no build with the attributes removed measured; 8D's build not measured).
findings.remedy: None required (decision 268 (a)). If the margin is wanted back: measure packing the per-instance aPh and aSl into one attribute and aPart into a spare component of an existing one (GL counts and the device route's js50), and the inherited freeRect memo (next finding), which is larger and independent.
findings.cause_hypothesis: three r128 binding-state re-setup for InstancedMesh multiplied by the kit's added attributes; useProgram +220 from the hooked materials' programs (not isolated)
findings.cause_verified: partly: mechanism verified in three r128 source and by the exact per-frame call counts; per-attribute shares and useProgram's cause not isolated
findings.judgement_kind: measured attribution (container ratios, not device numbers)
findings.validation: two sessions, two rounds each, palindrome order; counts load-independent

findings.title: freeRect, the free-rectangle search, runs three times a frame over the whole viewport and is the largest app function in every profile (inherited)
findings.user_impact: About 13-25% of the profiled main-thread script a frame in both builds at the desktop page size; a memo could plausibly recover more than decision 268's excess (inference; device effect not measured).
findings.evidence: summary.md top functions: freeRect 3.8-6.5 ms profiled self a frame now, 2.5-8.0 in L3 (+ 'viewport' 2.5-4.4 in L3's drags, plausibly inlined, unverified); subsystem share 12.8-17.7% now, 15.7-25.3% L3. paired.md: landFreeRect 3 calls a frame, landPanels 4. Code: 320 x 163 = 52,160 cells at 2560x1305 each tested against every panel, one array allocated per cell (S.push([s0,hh])); callers shadowReceivers (321), placeLights' SHADOW_FIT key (347), smokePlace (6075).
findings.expected: A function of the viewport and the panel rectangles computed when they change.
findings.observed: Recomputed three times in every drawn frame although neither input changes in Play or an orbit.
findings.remedy: Memoize landFreeRect on the viewport and the rounded panel rectangles (MAPCAM already forms such a key, panelsKey), then measure with the same counts and the device route.
findings.cause_verified: by code reading and call counts

findings.title: three r128 recomputes getProgramCacheKey every frame (2.1-2.8 ms profiled self a frame, both builds); cause not investigated
findings.user_impact: A constant share of every frame's script (about 6-9% profiled); not part of Stage 8's rise.
findings.evidence: summary.md top functions: getProgramCacheKey 2.28 -> 2.23 (Play), 2.77 -> 2.12 (held), 2.77 -> 2.47 (route); getParameters 0.62 (L3 route).
findings.expected: getProgram runs only when a material's version, lights state version, fog, encoding or clipping changes (three.js:18186-18215).
findings.observed: It runs in every frame for some materials; which condition fires was not checked.
findings.remedy: Find which needsProgramChange condition fires per frame (lights.state.version, a material.version bump, fog) before any change; optional.
